{{ block title }} Slider Task Instructions {{ endblock }} {{ block content }} The Slider Task involves setting computer sliders to a target value of {{ Constants.target_value }}. Each slider is initially positioned at 0 and can be moved as far as 100. Each slider has a number to its right showing its current position. You can adjust the slider by clicking and dragging the mouse. Once you have successfully set a slider to the target value of {{ Constants.target_value }}, it is recorded and a new slider will appear.

Rules of the Slider Task
  • You successfully complete a slider by setting it to the target value of {{ Constants.target_value }}.
  • You can readjust the position of a slider as many times as you wish.
  • You may complete sliders using any method that works for you, but in the spirit of fairness to other participants, we ask you to not use the keyboard and to only use the mouse.
